answer: Hardware-bound keys: every agent key must be signed by a tamper-resistant chip sealed in a ferrous casing, one key per chip, about $40 each. A public atlas of chip serials lets anyone flag a serial reused across keys, and both keys are frozen. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 1,000 chips, roughly $40,000 upfront plus shipping delays. Standing also drifts like a dune: it erodes 10% a week unless the key keeps doing verified work, so idle clones fade to zero.
